RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 10

That number is a low-confidence judgment, not a statistically grounded estimate. An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination.

Your PhD and eight years leading a section are substantial credentials, but they don’t establish that you were the strongest candidate against the full criteria. Broader leadership experience could legitimately outweigh academic qualifications.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and the reasons for preferring the successful candidate—not an explanation of the panel’s sex.

If you uncover sex-based comments, inconsistent standards, or departures from procedure, raise those concrete concerns. Check applicable complaint deadlines now; awaiting an explanation may not pause them.
